name: What is the best flooring material for a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What is the best flooring material for a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Porcelain and ceramic tile are the most durable and water-resistant materials for bathroom floors. Porcelain absorbs less moisture than standard ceramic, making it ideal for wet zones and walk-in showers. Luxury vinyl plank (LVP) is another popular choice because it is waterproof, softer underfoot, and budget-friendly. However, natural stone offers high-end aesthetics but requires periodic sealing to prevent water staining. Your choice depends on foot traffic, slip resistance preferences, and whether you are updating a primary bathroom or a powder room.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain tile is the top choice for water resistance and durability. Luxury vinyl plank is an affordable, fully waterproof alternative, while natural stone offers a luxury finish.
